prompts.name: Card_Blue
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production Unity UI sprite: a blank wide landscape rectangular product card with very thin beveled angular cyan-blue luminous metallic border, clipped chamfered corners, dark midnight-blue subtly textured empty opaque interior. Match the provided reference shop's blue card style precisely. Flat front view; aspect 2:1. No internal divider, no inset boxes, no text, no digits, no glyphs, no symbols, no icon, no treasure, no button, no watermark. Exterior transparent alpha. Empty large interior suitable for overlay TMP text/artwork. Border uniformly narrow and straight across middle spans for Unity 9slice; corner details confined to outer 12%. The reference is style guidance only.
